ITEM 1 | Pale cream-to-white meat cut, roughly 8 x 6 cm footprint, about 3 cm thick, with a golden-brown breaded or crumb-crusted edge and crispy, slightly flaky outer surface; lies at lower left of plate, moist-looking interior, holds its shape | 150
ITEM 2 | Yellow corn cob piece, two rounds, each about 3 cm across and 3 cm tall, bright yellow kernels with a slightly glossy surface, one round with cut face showing pale center; sits at upper left beside the grain | 110
ITEM 3 | Loose grain or rice-like mixture, tan-brown with small darker bits and scattered orange and green flecks, crumbly and dry-looking, spread about 7 x 5 cm in center of plate between corn and greens | 80
ITEM 4 | Mixed green salad leaves, dark and light green with pointed, lobed leaves, some wilted, matte surface, covering about 7 x 9 cm at upper right with a few stems | 40
ITEM 5 | Cauliflower florets, pale cream with small green-tinged edges, firm and slightly bumpy, about 2 to 3 cm each, clustered among the greens at right | 35
ITEM 6 | Thin slice of red radish, bright pink-red rim with white interior, about 3 cm long, tucked under greens at right edge | 5
